From NBN Network & Service Operations : Cables have arrived onsite and restoration works have commenced. Current ETR is 4pm.

From NBN Network & Service Operations : Restoration has been delayed due to the requirement for additional cables, which are expected to arrive on site at approximately 13:00. The revised ETR is 16:00 today,
The third-party network provider has confirmed a fibre cable cut due to vandalism. Current ETR provided is 1pm.
The third-party network providers technicians have arrived onsite and are investigating.
This incident is a Significant Local Outage as defined under the Telecommunications (Customer Communications for Outages) Industry Standard 2024.
The fault has been identified within a third-party provider’s network. Fibre technicians are enroute to the site, with an ETA currently unavailable.

nbn network engineers are investigating an alarm that indicates a possible fibre break on a network path that has caused a loss of service. If the issue is unable to be corrected remotely, a field technician will be sent to the site and perform investigations. Further updates will be provided as more information, or an ETA, becomes available.
